description: Well-graded gravel - maintains strength even when wet
Silty gravel - strength drops with saturation
Clayey gravel - gravel skeleton sustains load when wet
Silty sand - marginal GO for heaviest vehicles when wet
Clayey sand - RESTRICTED for heavy vehicles when wet
Silt - RESTRICTED all vehicles when wet
Lean clay - RESTRICTED all vehicles when wet
Organic silt - NOGO all vehicles when wet
Elastic silt (high plasticity) - NOGO all vehicles when wet
Fat clay - NOGO all vehicles when wet
Organic clay - NOGO all vehicles when wet
Peat - NOGO all vehicles when wet; RESTRICTED when dry/moist
